preconditions.description: The number of words in the scroll must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(word) <= 10**6 for word in words)
preconditions.description: Each word must have a length of at least 1 and the total length of all words must not exceed 1,000,000.
All words must consist of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The output must be the number of ways to recover the original scroll modulo 10^9+7.
The number of ways to recover the original scroll must be non-negative.

postconditions.expression: count == 0 if any(words[i] > words[i+1] for i in range(n-1)) else True
postconditions.description: If the words are not in lexicographically non-decreasing order, the output must be 0.
